collection.name: Museo Nacional de Arqueología, Antropología e Historia del Perú

notes: 1. At the beginning end, the primary cord has the remains of what was probably a red-colored tassel. 2. Subsidiary 63.1 is reinforced with a modern thread 3. Subsidiaries 70.1 and 71.1 are tied with only a thread to their respective pendants. 4. Cords 1.3, 12, 21.2 and 70 present variations of the figure eight knot 5. This khipu was described by Ascher and Ascher in 1978 (notes list this as AS047, however no match has been found in the database)

cords.note: Long knot valued at 10, cord value unknown
